text: ECOCHIC, a retail store, has two departments, ‘Sustainable Fashion and Fast Fashion’ for each of which stock account are kept. All the goods supplied to each department are debited to the stock account at cost plus a ‘mark-up’, which together make-up the selling-price of the goods and in the account of the sale proceeds of the goods are credited. The rate of ‘Markup’ for Sustainable Fashion is 33-1/3% of the cost for departmental transfer and 50% for sale in the open market and for Fast Fashion it is 10% of the cost for departmental transfer and 50% for sale in the open market.
